_about.purpose: Binding cross-family decisions for the 16 family fixers. Where a family file disagrees with this file, this file wins. Owner quotes stay verbatim; nothing here rewrites a quote.

conventions.priority: lower number runs first (meta always is the floor). Each family renumbers its rungs into ITS band rows below, keeping current relative order, values distinct to 2 decimals. A rung listed in a row's 'explicit' gets exactly that value.
conventions.mark_step_syntax: canonical step text: 'ladder_set mark <name> <true|false|value>'. Rewrite every 'ladder_set op mark name X value Y' / 'op=mark name=X value=Y' to that form so mechanical audits see the setter (several of critic's 27 'never set' marks are this syntax only).
conventions.hostiles_on_map: numeric everywhere (Sensors.cs line 162 writes a double): 0 for none, ">0" for some. Never "0" as a string, never true/false.
conventions.letter_substring: 'letter_labels: "~trader"' is not an operator: use the measured special key 'letter_matches: "trader"'.
conventions.pointer_rung: 'pointer' = delete the rung and add one line to that family's notes: 'see <owner-family>:<rung-id>'. Owner quotes the deleted rung carried move VERBATIM into the surviving rung's owner_rules; its useful steps merge into the survivor.
conventions.section_4b: critic section 5 stands: {ctu|ton: when, preset/hours, reset} is legal; do NOT 'fix' the 40 entries inventory 4b lists.

bands.rule: Bands never overlap. A family uses priorities only inside its own rows. A rung not named in any 'explicit' goes into its family's widest row, keeping relative order. Interlock marks (progression), not priority, sequence the stages; priority only orders rungs eligible at the same time. Safety order: owner/dialog < war alarm < survival combat < fight prep < chat < survival emergencies < start < setup < sustain.

rows.purpose: threat alarm + per-threat tactics (before every fight-loop rung)
chat first: below every combat rung, above every non-emergency; ties nothing
emergencies: fire, downed, medical, breaks, weather
generic camp chain, current relative order kept
sustain: food, cold, beds, medicine, storage, repairs, kitchen
base: mine/wall, power, defence, rooms, mountain base
recruiting, cash crops, dining, family, upgrades, second colony
infestation-prevent, bastions, organ, prison camp, weapons, prep, raids out

sensors.rule: Every rung key must be an existing Sensors.cs key or a canonical name here. EXISTS = rename the rung key. ALIAS = rename to the canonical TO_BUILD key. TO_BUILD = C# added in Sensors.cs (assembled method in inventory.md section C; this file is the per-key spec). TO_BUILD_HOST = gates.py writes it (meta family is host-side). A rung may sit on a TO_BUILD key (amber until built); never on any other unmeasured key.

power_margin_pct.where: RimPLC/Source/RimPLC/Sensors.cs normal cadence, new Sensors.ReadBuild(st, home, configuredPawns)
power_margin_pct.csharp: double prod = 0, cons = 0; foreach (Building b in home.listerBuildings.allBuildingsColonist) { CompPowerTrader pt = b.TryGetComp<CompPowerTrader>(); if (pt == null) continue; if (pt.PowerOutput > 0f) prod += pt.PowerOutput; else cons -= pt.PowerOutput; } if (cons > 0) st["power_margin_pct"] = Math.Round(prod / cons * 100.0);

progression.rule: Each stage mark is set by exactly one rung (or one per mutually exclusive kind) and cleared only by meta:new-colony. Every rung of a later stage reads the previous stage mark; no family starts a later stage's work without it. Alarm/emergency/meta rungs read no stage mark.
